item.title: what i learned about progressive enhancement
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on progressive enhancement, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Progressive enhancement shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: a short note about progressive enhancement
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting progressive enhancement wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Progressive enhancement shows up across web work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
